title: Capacity To Ship Packages Within D Days
goal: Find the least ship capacity that delivers ordered packages within the deadline.
strategy: Feasibility is monotone: a capacity that works makes every larger capacity work. Greedy day packing tests one candidate while binary search narrows the capacity interval.
